title: makerspet/oomwoo
claim: makerspet/oomwoo — An open-source robot vacuum: LiDAR SLAM on ESP32, ROS2, Home Assistant, fully hackable.
hook: An open-source robot vacuum you can build and flash yourself — LiDAR SLAM, ROS2 and Home Assistant, no cloud.
why_good: Roomba-class navigation (LiDAR SLAM on a cheap ESP32) as a fully open, hackable platform is what privacy-minded smart-home owners and robotics tinkerers have wanted — the Valetudo idea extended to the whole robot; 6.6k stars in seven weeks shows the pull.
value: A hardware-plus-firmware community play: assembled units, part kits, or a supported pro firmware and fleet dashboard for the home-lab and education market that already buys Prusa and Home Assistant gear.
risk: Hardware is capital- and support-heavy; staying a beloved DIY project is far easier than becoming a company, and iRobot and Roborock own manufacturing and price.

zh.claim: makerspet/oomwoo —— 开源扫地机器人:ESP32 上跑 LiDAR SLAM,支持 ROS2、Home Assistant,完全可魔改。
zh.hook: 一台你能自己组装、自己刷固件的开源扫地机器人——LiDAR SLAM、ROS2、接 Home Assistant,全程不上云。
zh.why_good: 把 Roomba 级导航(在便宜的 ESP32 上跑 LiDAR SLAM)做成完全开源、可魔改的平台,正是注重隐私的智能家居玩家和机器人爱好者想要的——把 Valetudo 的思路扩展到「整台机器人」;七周 6.6 千星说明有拉力。
zh.value: 走硬件 + 固件的社区路线:卖整机、零件套件,或面向已在买 Prusa、Home Assistant 的家庭实验室与教育市场,卖带支持的专业版固件和车队看板。
zh.risk: 硬件既烧钱又烧售后;当一个受欢迎的 DIY 项目,比做成一家公司容易太多,而 iRobot、石头科技握着制造与价格。
